content.value: In a company• 1000 applicants show up for 70 new job positions. The company takes a test to select the best candidates. The mean marks on this test turns out to be 60, with à standard deviation of 6. Can a peson who scores 84 count on getting one of the jobs? Assume that the marks distribution is symmetric about the mean.
